sections.overall: The Fright Night editions had plenty of decent matches but nothing exceptional this week. The best match was Kyle Fletcher vs Jack Perry (7.55) on Dynamite. This was a situation of the best match leading to a loss for both men, due to Fletcher's high rating going in. See the latest video in the "About" section for how this works!
sections.mens: The next strongest match, which did lead to gains for both men, was Ilja Dragunov vs The Beast Mortos (7.40), on Collision. As this is his second match, Dragunov officially enters the rankings! How long until he cracks the top 10?
sections.womens: Queen Aminata vs Persephone (7.38) was a memorable TBS title change, main evented Dynamite and was the biggest points gain for any wrestlers this week. Jamie Hayter and Alex Windsor both drop from the ratings, but will be back next week after Blood and Guts!
sections.menstag: Although FTR vs The Motor City Machine Guns (7.00) was the third consecutive 7+ rated match, it was a small loss for the former, due to the expectation rating being higher since theirs and MCMG's ratings have risen recently.
sections.womenstag: The champs, The Brawling Birds, drop out the rankings (see Women's). Sisters of Sin did feature in the Trios match and various tags will be part of Blood and Guts next week!
sections.trios: For the first time in a while, The Demand don't feature in the rankings after dropping out. Hopefully they will return soon! Cassidy, O'Reilly and Strong vs Gunns & Robinson (6.02) was a decent but unspectacular main event on Collision, so little impact on the ratings for these teams.
